CFML Language Reference: Functions

HTMLEditFormat

Returns a string with the characters <, >, & and " replaced by &lt;, &gt;, &amp; and &quot;, and carriage returns removed. Text processed this way shows up in the browser exactly as typed instead of being interpreted as markup.

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

HTMLEditFormat(string [, version ])

Parameters

string
The text to escape.
version
Optional. The HTML version to target: "-1", "2.0" or "3.2". Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always uses the same set of entities.

Returns

The escaped string.

Usage

Always run user-supplied text through this function before you display it, and before you put it in the VALUE attribute of a form field: a stray double quote would otherwise end the attribute early, and a stray <SCRIPT> would run in your visitors' browsers.

HTMLCodeFormat does the same thing and adds PRE tags around the result.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Comment" DEFAULT="I <B>love</B> this site & its ""cool"" tags!">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Raw output</TH><TD>#URL.Comment#</TD></TR>
<TR><TH>HTMLEditFormat</TH><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(URL.Comment)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<FORM ACTION="htmleditformat.cfm" METHOD="get">
<INPUT TYPE="text" NAME="Comment" SIZE="50" VALUE="#HTMLEditFormat(URL.Comment)#">
<INPUT TYPE="submit" VALUE="Try it">
</FORM>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also
